analysis: This PR is documentation-only: it adds changelog.d/base-reward-zero-reason.md and docs/provider/base-rewards.md, a nav link in docs/README.md:15, and a pointer paragraph in docs/provider/hardware-requirements.md (head lines 63-66). No code, protocol, key custody, attestation, authorization or cache-storage behavior changes, so TB-002, TB-003, TB-007, TB-009 and TB-011 are unaffected, as are T-041 and the A-001..A-017 assets. The new page tells operators to run `darkbloom report` and states that App Attest snapshot and system logs are uploaded (base-rewards.md lines 20-21 and 73-86). It warns against pasting hostnames, serials, provider keys or tokens into a public issue, and recommends `--dry-run` first, which is a reasonable privacy hygiene control. It links to public GitHub issues 878, 1601 and 1553, which is a mild disclosure-hygiene concern only if operators ignore the warning. The page repeats snapshot-vs-deployed-policy caveats and does not assert authorization or ranking guarantees, consistent with T-052, T-055 and T-058's anti-overclaim posture. Open question for later review: the content of the report upload (what `darkbloom report` collects and its retention) is outside the supplied evidence, so T-058's identity-linkage concern for report contents cannot be assessed here. Cited source paths (DoctorRunner.swift, DesktopAccountEarnings.swift) were not supplied for verification. No security regression identified.
